_note: Opening sequence (decisions/0016 Part 2). DRAFT captions for Fordham staff to check. 'frames' is how long a caption stays up at 30 frames per second; players can press Z to move on sooner or X to skip to the controls. Consecutive beats with the same 'scene' play as one continuous animation.

beats.caption: Your first week at Fordham University starts today.
Fordham is a Jesuit university, founded in 1841.
Rose Hill, here in the Bronx, is Fordham's original campus.
Fordham also has campuses at Lincoln Center in Manhattan and in Westchester.
Fordham's teams are the Rams. You'll see the Ram all over campus.

controls.title: HOW TO PLAY
controls.tip: Gray = road, tan = walkway. Cross at the crosswalks.
controls.prompt: Press Z, then walk through the gate!
